name: persist-model
description: Processing container for persisting a newly trained classification model into the shared models volume and syncing it into the kaapana-backend database

templates.description: Store a training run's model output in the shared /models volume, then sync all installed classification models for the DAG into the kaapana-backend

env.name: DAG_ID
env.description: Not injected by KaapanaTaskOperator (see migration-notes.md) — the subdirectory of the shared /models volume this DAG's checkpoints live under. Statically overridden per DAG in workflow_definition.py.

env.name: KAAPANA_PROJECT_IDENTIFIER
env.description: Injected per-task by the workflow-api (see airflow_adapter.py) with the triggering DAG run's project id. Used to fetch the full project object from the access-information-interface and build the Project header required by kaapana-backend's /client/installed_models/sync endpoint.

inputs.name: model
inputs.description: The training task's output: checkpoint(s), config.json, and training.log for this run.
